facts.fact: The article says the National Digital Strategy launched in 2025, with the Sixth National Development Plan, charts digital infrastructure through 2025/26 to 2029/30, with a target of raising internet use from 53% to 90% by 2030; the period had not ended and no successor is named.

note: Only the standing fact: no money or progress against the strategy's targets is tied to it. The Digital Government Strategic Roadmap 2024-2026 is not a broadband plan.
